notes.title: Dogsled survival adventure Arctico leaves Early Access in February
notes.content: rctico was previously an Early Access survival game called Eternal Winter, but it ditched all the bleak inevitability of starving to death in the snow in favor of becoming a relaxing exploration game. With “Arctico” we are trying to make a calm exploration and base building game, a game you can play at your own pace, a game that offers beautiful lonely silent landscapes, a game that rewards you for studying and exploring this island.

notes.title: a word about Nicaragua and the state of Eternal Winter
notes.content:
You may or may not know about the horrible situation unfolding in our country. Nicaragua is going through a very dark moment, our government has killed 90+ people, and many more are missing. Everyone is afraid, and everyone has been forced to put their life goals, dreams and ambitions on hold. The streets are not safe, expressing yourself is not safe. In the past days we realized our freedom was long gone. 

Before these events we were about to release a very substantial update, I even worked a little on the game while young students were killed on the streets, they were killed protesting for our rights, for my rights. 

So today we (Antonio, Claudio) are officially putting the development of Eternal Winter on hold. 

For now our skills and time will be used to tell more about what happened in Nicaragua to anyone willing to listen, and we’ll do this through our favorite medium, game development.

Once this project is done and things are more stable we will get back to work on Eternal Winter.

notes.title: alpha v.4 huge content update
notes.content:
Please start a new game so everything works properly

Changelog: 

-Map: added tons of new things to explore including icebergs.

New tool
-Binoculars: right click to zoom in and left click to set a waypoint towards the area you are looking at.

STRUCTURES/BASE CAMP
-Astrophotography kit: dynamic way of collecting data.
-Tall flag
-Data scanner
-Camera traps
-Improved light: you can now change the color of the lights you place
-every single structure has been rescaled and optimized
-Small rocks added as a decor to big structures. 
-new lumber mill model and props.
-new hardware welder model and props.
-new tent model
-new water deposit model.
-new sfx when placing structures.
-“unpacking process” after placing a structure the npc in charge has to unpack his equipment before being able to work.

STARTING A NEW GAME
-Choose expedition flag color
-Choose your specialty (geologist, biologist, and meteorologist) this will allow you to collect more data from some items/structures.
-improved dog naming process.

ITEMS
-Tissue/cell sample: get it from dead animals and algae.
-Camera sd: camera traps 

ANIMALS
-Walrus
-Seal
-Orca (rare spawns)

DATA SCANNER
-A new structure that allows you to retrieve data from items you find in the map, including damaged hard drives and skin samples.

PETITIONS/UPLOADING DATA
-Uploading data will now grant exposure which translates into signatures for your petitions to protect marine areas, a larger marine area under protection means a higher positive impact on the ecosystem.

CAMERA TRAPS
-Regular traps have been replaced by camera traps, small autonomous cameras that track the movement of animals. They must be placed close to dens, you can retrieve the camera SD every day and use a data scanner to convert it into data. 

SOLAR PANESL
-This is the new energy producing structure, they follow the sun and only generate power while the sun is up.

NPCS
- Distinct idle animation, improved interaction process. 

STARTING ZONE
-A radically improved starting area, npcs that provide tips and more.
- You can now send a pilot on recruitment trips by providing the food required for the new members.

OTHER
-Sled: sled will go slower when going uphill
-kayak: you can now use your kayak by simply standing close to water and pressing “E” 
-Added inventory menu animations
-updated help menu
-added special data collection areas
-added algae growing on thin ice in some areas around the island
-Each animal now gives a distinct amount of meat, and also animal cell samples. 

Some of the fixes:
-huge optimization improvement
-fixed input bug that was heavily affecting the game’s performance.
-fixed antialiasing/ssao bug that caused frame drops when getting too close to npcs or game objects.
-fixed seeing through objects if you were close enough (camera bug) 
-fixed color correction bug that was causing camera artifacts to appear on dark surfaces. 
-fixed water rendering before distant trees 
-fixed stars not rendering 
-fixed penguins not spawning when loading/continuing a game. 
-fixed penguins rotation bug
-fixed “Quit” menu button.
-Smaller, cleaner UI when interacting with expedition members. 
- fixed weather monitors and ice drills resource check bug.
-fixed co-op player animation system breaking after some time.

notes.title: alpha v.32 changelog
notes.content:
These are the major changes in alpha v.32

-The expedition update adds a new objective to the game “Data collection”, you will be able to place weather monitors, collect data from buoys in the open sea, and then upload this data to get different rewards (from critical items like med kits to items that will allow you to customize the look of your base)

-Added small intro

-Animal AI: deer, lion, wolf will now evade trees when they either chasing or running away from you.

-Npcs now have their own name and “efficiency” level, this affects how they perform the tasks assigned by the player. I.E a hunter with a high efficiency level will bring more meat after a hunting trip. 

-Npcs now sleep, this makes them unavailable for work at certain hours.
-You can now customize the look of your base by using paint buckets.

-Major improvements to the building process, now you are able to see how large structures will be placed and everything is more dynamic. 

-New structures: 

-Hardware welder (replaces metal gatherer, and hardware components replace the “metal” resource)
-Antenna: Allows you to upload data, an antenna is also required to start setting up a new base.
-Eco-ranger: Makes use of local data to go on eco-friendly campaigns which will improve the health of the ecosystem.
-Tent: cheap to build, allows you to sleep and save your game anywhere.
-Weather monitor, ice caps monitor: use them to gather data every dayl

-Storms no longer send you back in time, they will now wipe your resources and local data if you do not meet the demands. 

-New map with improved flow and balance. 

-Day/night transition system color palette revised and improved. 

-New ambient occlusion technique. 

-Player 2 is now able to build some structures, including: traps, weather and ice caps monitor, 

-Huge improvements to the UI.

-Penguins.

-You can now change between gun and tools by using keys 1,2,3,4,5

-Your arms and tools now take less space in the screen.

notes.title: Development road for may and june
notes.content:
As you guys know we are not happy with the current map of Eternal Winter, we believe that a good map could make a radical difference for the game. We want you to feel eager to explore every inch of the map, and to deliver a truly enjoyable  experience with each location, tree and rock. That is why on the coming 8 weeks we will be working around the clock to create an amazing map. We will start from 0, meaning we will throw away every current location in the map, we will redefine the general style and look of the buildings/structures/houses in the game so you can really feel in a post-apocalyptic setting where nature is slowly eating and reclaiming what is left of humanity. We will also try to tell small stories with each location and object you find, stories that will tell you more about what happened, what kind of people/society lived in this island...we are looking forward to the end of june!

We will also work on:
-Animals and dogs AI
-Adding more wildlife
-Key binds options
-Optimizing the game
-Adding more tools and items
-More interactions with the dogs
much more!

Note: updates in the month of may will keep flowing normally, however in june they might slow down so we can deliver the map by the end of that month.

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: Eternal Winter
notes.content:
Each week Marsh Davies staggers off into the barren, frigid wilderness of Early Access and comes back with whatever stories and/or slabs of dog meat he can find. This week he sticks on his mitts and braces for subzero survival sim Eternal Winter.

There s good and bad failure in games. Good failure teaches you something, whether about your own resolve and ingenuity or the world these things are tested against. Good failure is a dynamic, riveting generator of experience. Bad failure is, I fear, what the vast majority of indie survival sims have to offer: a way of capping off a game with no definite trajectory. Like wading into chest-high cement, you do eventually stop, but you wouldn t call it much of a journey.

notes.content:
Ok so I just uploaded the last and definite video for the Early Access launch day. It show some exciting new features that were not previously announced. Below you will find the features that will be supported when the game becomes available on Early Access. You can name your dogs!

FEATURES: 

-Dog sled to make moving around the extensive map easier 
-Dogs are not inmortal, you must feed them, manage their energy, you even get the chance to name them every time you start a new game. 
-Huge map filled with interesting locations to explore and safe houses to loot. 
-No loading screens from exterior to interiors 
-Well balanced survival mechanics inspired by the real needs of the human body. These include: 
-Hunger 
-Thirst 
-Temperature 
-Weight management (inventory) 
-A day/night cycle that affects the temperature and other factors in the world. 
-A diverse wildlife to hunt or run from: Bears, wolves, boars, foxes. 
-A simple yet effective looting system. 
-A fully functional saving system.
